page_title: iMean AI: AI Trip Planner | Flights, Hotels & Travel Ideas

summary.name: iMean AI
summary.one_liner: iMean AI is an AI trip planner that suggests cheap flights, hotels, destinations, and day-by-day itineraries based on user preferences.
use_cases: Finding cheap flights for a trip
Choosing hotels that fit a budget
Picking destinations for family, romantic, or adventure trips
summary.what_it_does: The page describes iMean AI as a web-based AI trip planner for flights, hotels, destinations, and itineraries. It says the AI scans flight deals to surface low fares, including last-minute tickets and fare trackers. It generates one-click day-by-day itineraries and hotel options tailored to budget and style. Users can update preferences and the plan adjusts. The page does not describe how bookings are completed or which data sources or airlines are covered beyond saying it uses real-time data.
notable: Free daily access with a premium plan at $6.99/month for unlimited planning
Works for solo, family, or business trips and domestic or international travel
Fully responsive on desktop and mobile browsers
caveats: Unlimited trip planning requires the premium plan at $6.99/month
Accuracy claims (real-time data) are marketing statements not independently verified on the page
Page does not specify which airlines, hotels, or booking partners are included
